instruction: Access the Troubleshooting Information page in Thunderbird. This page provides diagnostic information about your Thunderbird installation.

metadata.explanation: Task requires opening the Troubleshooting Information tab in Thunderbird. Similar to original task but targets Troubleshooting Information instead of About Profiles. Uses accessibility tree to verify the Troubleshooting Information tab is open.
metadata.similarity_to_original: high - same app, same interaction pattern (open tab), similar complexity

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts accessibility tree from environment, which is the appropriate state to verify UI elements like tabs
Metric check_accessibility_tree correctly uses CSS selector to locate the Troubleshooting Information tab within Thunderbird's page-tab-list
Complete instruction coverage: evaluator verifies the tab is open, which confirms the page has been accessed
CSS selector is well-formed and semantically correct: 'application[name=Thunderbird] page-tab-list[attr|id="tabmail-tabs"]>page-tab[name="Troubleshooting Information"]'
No postconfig needed - tab state is directly accessible in the accessibility tree after task completion
Expected value matches instruction requirement exactly - checks for specific tab name
Uses only official existing functions (get_accessibility_tree getter and check_accessibility_tree metric) with correct logic
